notes:
Account summary: enterprise support platform serving 6k customers. Primary initiative: reduce live-agent load via RAG-driven ticket deflection + AI assistant. Key metrics: target top-5 rerank precision high (measured by top-5 MRR / deflection rate), strict E2E latency SLO <= 250ms p50 and <= 450ms p99 for standard queries. -- Index scale: planning 1M docs for initial POC, long-term 30-50M documents (KBs, tickets, macros, KB article revisions). Expect heavy metadata filtering (customer_id, product_line) - per-customer slices. Cost sensitivity: aim for <$0.005 per query average at scale; willing to trade small latency for cost via caching/prefix-KV but insist on predictable p99 behavior.

POC scope (agreed in meeting):
- Week 1: ingest 1M exported tickets + KB, validate embedding pipeline, baseline retrieval latency on dedicated nodes.
- Week 2: add reranker (cross-encoder candidate) to measure top-5 quality, tune candidate pool size, produce deflection estimate.
- Deliverables: latency breakdown (retrieve + rerank), cost per query projection at 100QPS and 500QPS, top-5 precision/recall numbers, runbook for on-prem/VPC deployment.

Technical constraints / asks:
- Must support per-tenant data residency (EU/NA) with audit logs retained 12 months.
- KMS integration required; they run Azure Key Vault (ask for HSM-compatible options).
- Reranker must be able to run on quantized 8-bit for cost but preserve ranking fidelity for top-5.
- Expected traffic: baseline 60 QPS, peak 350 QPS across global regions (NA primary).

Sales notes / quotes: "If we can hit ~200ms median and show consistent top-5 results, we can push this to our PLG customers in 2 quarters" - Elena Kovacs, VP Support.
"We need a realistic cost curve at 100k queries/day" - Head of Product.

Objections: security wants private control plane; infra wants clear autoscale for dedicated pool; ML team wants retraining hooks and evaluation telemetry for reranker regression alerts.

Next steps (short): schedule infra deep-dive, set up access for Drive export, confirm indexing cadence and retention rules. Open items: SSO SAML metadata, legal NDA for on-prem package, clarification on SLA expectations and rollback policy for model rollouts.
